prompt: Which statements about go run, go build, and gofmt are true?
explanation: go build outputs a static binary runnable without Go installed; go run is compile+run in one step; gofmt is the single formatting standard.

options.text: go run compiles and runs the program in one step
go build produces a single static binary that needs no separate runtime
go build requires the Go toolchain to be installed on the target machine to run the binary
gofmt enforces one canonical formatting style
